defenses.reason: The test file lacks a test case for edit with an unknown ID and no field options. The function test_ac4_no_field_and_unknown_id_are_errors tests edit 1 with no options (line 102), edit 99 with --title (line 103), and edit 99 with --priority (line 105), but does not test edit 99 with no field options. This gap means the test suite would not catch a regression if the check order were changed to report 'nothing to edit' before checking if the ID exists.
